paper_title: Light Dark Matter Search with Ionization Signals in XENON1T
notes: Paper constrains multiple DM models. Dark photon absorption limit reported as kinetic mixing kappa over mass range 0.186-1 keV. Only one explicit numerical point available (Table I): m=0.5 keV, kappa=2.2e-16. Paper also constrains ALPs via g_ae (e.g. m=0.5 keV, g_ae=7.7e-14) and various scattering models. Full exclusion curve only available in Figure 5F (not numerically extractable).
